name: Studied Combatant
category: Everyman Gaming, LLC – Rogue Talents, Advanced
body:
Prerequisite(s): Advanced talents

Benefit(s): A rogue that selects this talent gains Studied Combatant as a bonus feat. If the rogue already has this feat, she gains Improved Studied Combatant instead. She must meet these feats’ prerequisites. The rogue can select this talent up to two times.
